value.hook: Open before pushing a PR round, especially after main moved or during a load cap
value.title: PR hygiene traps: DIRTY means no CI, read biome output, shared-target binaries

sections.name: body
sections.value:
- A PR that conflicts with main (gh pr view N --json mergeStateStatus = DIRTY) gets NO CI runs at all. If a push shows no runs, check that first and merge main.
- Read biome's output, not just its tail. A clean run prints "Checked N files ... No fixes applied" with no "Found N errors". I once pushed unformatted TS because the check printed nothing I read.
- On the shared cargo target, test binaries keep the same hashed name across worktrees. Copy one aside (/tmp) right after its build if another worktree's build may relink it before you run it.
- Load cap (prime, 2026-11-08): CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4 on every cargo run and --test-threads=4 on test binaries. A source-scanning test (spawn_sites, extension_closure) reads the tree at run time, so mutate sources and rerun the same binary: a mutation check with no rebuild.
- An extension identity change ripples into display tests (OMP footer and session name regexes in index.test.ts). Grep tests for the old format before pushing.
